name: Slice-based Solid Voxelization
aliases: GPU-accelerated multi-valued solid voxelization by slice functions
definition: A real-time technique to voxelize closed surface-based geometric objects into solid volumetric representations with multi-valued interior materials by using depth/stencil buffers for surface parity checking and applying slice functions to generate solid slices.
summary: Slice-based Solid Voxelization is a GPU-accelerated algorithm that converts closed surfaces into multi-valued volumetric models by assigning interior material properties via dynamic slice functions, avoiding the binary outputs of XOR-based methods.
